gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use the Orthen teleportation device (requires activation unlocked by the research Incomplete Portal Network III, 20 un-noted quintessence, and level 70 Divination) to teleport there

• Walk from Laniakea using teleportation of Slayer cape or the master variant
• Walk from Anachronia base camp
• There are three routes requires 1, 30, and 50 Agility respectively
• Walk from the Totem of the Abyss placed on totem pedestal
• Walk from Orthen Oubliette using teleportation of Boss portal to Raksha, the Shadow Colossus
• Walk from spirit grove using teleportation of Boss portal to Rex Matriarchs

30194.d: Yanille is a members-only town that lies to the south of Ardougne.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Home Teleport to Yanille lodestone
• Watchtower Teleport, toggled to Yanille after completing the Ardougne Set Tasks - Hard.
• Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars
• To the north lies the Fight Arena, the Tree Gnome Village, a Monastery, Port Khazard and (further north) East Ardougne
• To the south lies the Ogre City of Gu'Tanoth
• To the east of Castle Wars
• To the east is a small archipelago inhabited by a gnome named Hazelmere
• To the north-west is the Watchtower (cast Watchtower Teleport, level 58 Magic required)
• To the north is a fairy ring teleport, CIQ
• Inside the town is a POH portal, which can be reached with a House Teleport spell or tablet if your player-owned house is located in Yanille. If the Love Story quest has been completed, a yanille tablet (made from a chipped teleport to house tablet) can be used to teleport to the Yanille house portal, even if your house is located elsewhere.

30195.d: The Yanille Agility Dungeon (also known as Yanille Dungeon) is the dungeon under the town of Yanille.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Players must go to the Yanille area to reach the dungeon. Other than walking, there are a few ways to get there:
• The Watchtower Teleport to the Watchtower, which is quite close to the dungeon's northern entrance. This teleport ability is a reward of the Watchtower quest.
• The House Teleport to Yanille, if the player has a house and has located it in Yanille.
• The Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars, which is west of Yanille.
• Fairy ring code CIQ, which arrives north-west of Yanille. Partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings.
• Teleport using the Ardougne Cape 1 to the Monastery to the north of Yanille.
• Teleport using the Home teleport to the Yanille Lodestone to the west of Yanille.
• Modifying a Teleport to House tablet, so it will let you teleport to the Yanille House Portal.
